column1: # Every MHC name VDJdb records that IPD-IMGT/HLA cannot adjudicate, because it is not human.
# This file is that adjudication: a name in it resolves, a name outside it fails the build.
# `proofreading/mhc.md` section 7 is the prose, including why murine names carry the MGI `H2-` prefix.
# `level` says what kind of name it is, which is why two rows can describe one molecule:
#   allele     a named allele in a species database (IPD-MHC for Mamu)
#   molecule   a haplotype-bearing molecule name, the murine convention
#   chain      an MGI chain-gene symbol, carrying no haplotype, so it names no single molecule
#   invariant  not an MHC gene at all
# `species` is `*` where the name is species-independent. Nothing reads it yet; it is here so a
# call on the wrong organism becomes checkable without re-deriving this table.
# Lines starting with # are comments and are ignored.
